g.text: DB client and device-layer latency (separate metrics)
Device-layer averages = diskstats accumulated milliseconds / completed requests; includes all processes and in-flight boundary effects. Not
NVMe physical latency percentiles. Client: E scan, others point lookup. N/A is not zero.
